data.name: Uganda Jam Sessions

recipes.label: 30 g · NEO
recipes.tip: Medium-dark natural brewed at Round Boy’s recommended 93°C, pulled back to 92°C for the longer V60 drawdown (their guide: 15 g : 225 g, about 2:10). It gives up its sugars easily, so the grind runs half a number coarser than the light roasts. Expect jammy plum and raspberry over cocoa. If it turns ashy or bitter on the longer V60 drawdown, drop to 90°C before touching the grind; if thin, go half a number finer.

data.name: Brazil Recanto

recipes.label: 30 g · NEO
recipes.tip: Low-grown Brazilian natural, roasted medium-dark: the most soluble coffee in the deck, so it runs cool and three-quarters of a number coarser than the light roasts. Expect hazelnut-chocolate, caramel and a soft, round body with little acidity. If it turns ashy or bitter, drop to 88°C; if it tastes hollow, go half a number finer. Round Boy suggests two weeks of rest.
